items.name: Take-home prasad kit
items.description: A take-home prasad kit lets devotees carry the temple experience home and share prasad with family.

items.name: Saarthi ambulance
items.description: An ambulance near the temple exit reassures elderly devotees that medical help is close if needed.

items.name: Pre-booked thali
items.description: Offerings are prepared in advance. A volunteer matches the devotee’s token to the pre-booked thali at the top-most checkpoint.

items.name: Offering tokens
items.description: A token received at entry connects the devotee to their pre-booked offerings further along the route.

items.name: Saarthi T-shirt
items.description: A recognisable Saarthi T-shirt helps devotees identify volunteers at the temple and along the route.

items.name: Saarthi App
items.description: The app offers digital access to the service. Family members can also use Saarthi on a senior’s behalf; WhatsApp provides an alternative.

items.name: Saarthi volunteer
items.description: Volunteers greet devotees, check their Saarthi pass, assist with footwear and tokens, and offer support at checkpoints.

items.name: Driver
items.description: Drivers support the journey to and from the temple, with cab details shared before the visit.

items.name: Temple
items.description: The temple is the heart of the experience, with Saarthi supporting the journey around darshan and worship.

items.name: Checkpoints
items.description: Calm checkpoints along the route provide shade, seating, water and volunteer assistance.

items.name: Exit rest station
items.description: A place to sit after darshan, receive returned slippers and prepare for the journey home.

items.name: Share a ride
items.description: Saarthi can suggest a shared ride with another devotee from the same area. Devotees can accept or decline.

items.name: Cab
items.description: Booked transport supports travel to the temple and a coordinated return journey.

items.name: WhatsApp
items.description: Devotees can use Saarthi entirely through WhatsApp, without learning a new app.

items.name: Simple questions
items.description: The welcome conversation asks about the temple, preferred days and usual visit timings.

items.name: Daily updates
items.description: Updates share aarti timings, crowd levels and estimated waiting time to help devotees plan their visit.

items.name: Forecast board
items.description: The Darshan Forecast Board at the entrance provides crowd and waiting-time information on arrival.

items.name: Ride bookings
items.description: Ride booking lets devotees arrange transport as part of planning their temple visit.

items.name: Cab details
items.description: Cab information is shared after booking so devotees know their transport arrangements.

items.name: Primary volunteer details
items.description: Details of the primary volunteer help devotees know whom to look for when they arrive.

items.name: Audio story
items.description: An audio story accompanies the journey, connecting the visit with the temple’s cultural and devotional context.

items.name: Saarthi App
items.description: The app is another channel for service information, alongside WhatsApp and on-site touchpoints.
